layouts.name: Texas World Speedway
layouts.description: Draft configuration: The organizer identifies the historical 2.9-mile, 15-turn road course and its final events in 2017. The catalogue configuration identifies the Northern kink, full external technical sector, two Southern returns and inner hairpin. The pinned 2015 independent source retains that complete course rather than the oval-only or short configurations. The 4520.2 m trace remains unscaled against the 4556 m catalogue scalar; historical temporary barriers and fine corner detail remain draft. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 4520.2 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.
